title: registry: platform and environment package-less action items share one slot per name; the later registration erases the other
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czXwx6JtQPvacrzzUw

Split out of #32996 item 2 (seat ruling below). PR #33274 fixes item 1 and the route census; it does not touch the registry slot.

Filing gate: seat routing. class: b · type: Defect · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: `domain:server` · lease: E1.

## What happens

A platform action item bound to `lead` and the environment's object-less item of the same name occupy one package-less slot in the metadata registry. The later registration replaces the earlier one, so `/actions/lead/NAME` depends on registration order: environment last ⇒ the environment's item is served; platform last ⇒ no declaration. The same slot rule holds on main's zero-holder bare read.

## Ruling (seat, revised after a Fable review)

- The registry keeps **both** package-less items; they are two different ADR-0150 D4 keys — `(platform, lead, NAME)` and `(environment, global, NAME)` — not one contested name. Neither registration erases the other.
- **Binding first, then owner:** `/actions/lead/NAME` serves the platform item bound to `lead` (as `addressedActionHits` / `actionHandlerObjectKeys` already order bound-before-object-less); D3's environment-first applies only within one key. The environment's object-less item is served on every other route. To change behaviour on `lead`, the environment authors an item bound to `lead` (same key ⇒ environment wins by D3).
- **Red line:** today's "environment registered last" cell serves the environment's declaration while dispatch runs the platform's `lead`-bound handler, so `actionPermissionError` gates on the environment item's `requiredPermissions`, not the platform's — a permission bypass. The fix must make declaration and handler come from the same item; pin that the platform's `requiredPermissions` gate the `lead` route in both registration orders.
- Pin each cell in both registration orders, one ablation per pin; declare the moved answer (`Clause-②`).

Reader who acts: the metadata registry's package-less action slot (E1 owns `packages/metadata-protocol/src/**` and the stored-row slot model); route side `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` is E2b — coordinate if the census needs a read change.
